item.title: Russia's war in Ukraine: the situation
item.description:

Russia has also violated Finnish airspace with a helicopter and Polish airspace with an unmanned aerial vehicle, prompting NATO to pledge defence against a reported Russian space threat. The UN Security Council warned that winter attacks on Ukraine’s power grid and Black Sea shipping threaten lives and global food supplies. The conflict caused 75,767 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.

item.title: Sudan's civil war: the situation
item.description:
RSF forces have stepped up drone attacks, striking a United Nations building and residential neighborhoods in Khartoum, killing four people, and hitting civilians in Blue Nile state, killing 19 and displacing thousands near Ed Damazin. RSF-aligned troops assaulted aid offices in Nyala and a shelter in West Kordofan, causing civilian casualties. A RSF counterintelligence chief and a commander have defected to the Sudanese army in Khartoum, indicating shifting loyalties. New displacement alerts show thousands fleeing to locations such as Al Ferdous in East Darfur and As Salam in West Kordofan, while dengue fever cases are reported in El Geneina, West Darfur. The conflict produced 4,680 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.
